firstLines: Nathan Kim
Denver, CO | (720) 555-0115 | nathan.kim@example.com | linkedin.com/in/nathankim | github.com/nathankim
SUMMARY
Data analyst with three years in e-commerce, working mostly in SQL, dbt and Looker. I like turning a messy
question from marketing or operations into one clear chart and a recommendation.
EXPERIENCE
Talus & Tern Outdoor Supply Denver, CO
Data Analyst Apr 2023 – Present
• Built the Looker dashboard for weekly sales and returns that 40 managers use; it replaced six emailed
spreadsheets
• Found through a cohort analysis that free-shipping customers returned 2x more often; the threshold change
saved $380K a year
• Moved 25 reporting queries into dbt models with tests, cutting broken-report tickets from about 10 a month to 2
• Designed the A/B test readout template the marketing team now uses for every email and site test
Larkmead Credit Union Boulder, CO
Junior Data Analyst Jul 2021 – Mar 2023
• Wrote SQL and Excel reports on loan applications for the lending team and automated three of them in Python
• Cleaned five years of member data before a core system migration and documented every field mapping
• Answered ad hoc questions from branch managers, usually the same day
PROJECTS
Colorado Trail Usage | Python, BigQuery, Streamlit 2024
• Public dashboard of trailhead counts from state open data; featured in a local outdoor newsletter
EDUCATION
Cottonhollow University Fort Collins, CO
Bachelor of Science in Statistics May 2021
SKILLS
Languages: SQL, Python (pandas), R
Tools: Looker, Tableau, dbt, Snowflake, BigQuery, Excel
Methods: A/B testing, cohort analysis, forecasting
Certifications: dbt Analytics Engineering, Tableau Desktop Specialist
